description: Broken catalogs. Each case changes one thing in a copy of the real catalog (file, then an entry by id: set or drop fields; or add an entry; or top: set top-level fields) and lists text the checker's messages must contain. Run by frontend/tests/catalog.test.mjs (check.mjs) and backend/tests/test_catalog.py (catalog.py). Messages from the meaning layer are word for word the same in both; shape messages differ, so those cases only name the file, entry and field.

cases.name: an item in an unknown region
expect: items.json: moonwheat: region "nowhere" is not in regions.json

cases.name: a recipe input that isn't an item
expect: recipes.json: wooden_sickle: input "oak_log" is not in items.json

cases.name: a loot weight of zero
expect: loot.json: moonwheat_crop: weight of "moonwheat" must be > 0

cases.name: loot count with min above max
expect: loot.json: ashwind_tree: count of "ashwind_log" is [4, 2]: min above max

cases.name: recipes that loop
expect: recipes.json: recipes loop: moonwheat → moonwheat_seeds → moonwheat

cases.name: a duplicate item id
expect: items.json: duplicate id "moonwheat"

cases.name: an item without a rarity
expect: items.json: moonwheat
rarity

cases.name: an item without a model
expect: items.json: sunberry
model

cases.name: a rarity outside the palette
expect: items.json: glowcap
rarity
mythic

cases.name: an unknown field
expect: items.json: moonwheat
colour

cases.name: an unknown stat
expect: items.json: wing_blades
stats
power

cases.name: a stacking tool
expect: items.json: wooden_sickle: a tool doesn't stack (stack must be 1)

cases.name: a tool without a skill
expect: items.json: wooden_sickle: a tool needs a "skill"

cases.name: gear needing an unknown skill
expect: items.json: wing_blades: requires "swordplay" is not in skills.json

cases.name: a telegraph too short to read
expect: enemies.json: wisp: telegraph of 0.3 s is under 0.6 s

cases.name: an enemy with an unknown loot table
expect: enemies.json: wisp: loot "nothing" is not in loot.json

cases.name: quests that loop
expect: quests.json: quests loop: first_harvest → tea_for_wick → sickle_of_your_own → first_harvest

cases.name: a quest goal of the wrong shape
expect: quests.json: glacier_road: a gather goal takes "item", "count"

cases.name: a curve of the wrong length
expect: skills.json: runecrafting: curve "short" has 24 steps, 30 levels need 29

cases.name: a missing curve
expect: skills.json: runecrafting: curve "tiny" is not in curves

cases.name: a skill unlocking an unknown recipe
expect: skills.json: foraging: unlock at level 5: recipe "golden_axe" is not in recipes.json

cases.name: a region beyond the world's edge
expect: regions.json: shellshore: reaches 7500 m from the hub, beyond worldRadius 6000

cases.name: an unknown biome
expect: regions.json: shellshore
biome

cases.name: an NPC offering an unknown quest
expect: npcs.json: angler: line "hello" offers quest "big_fish", not in quests.json

cases.name: an NPC line leading nowhere
expect: npcs.json: lamplighter: line "hello" leads to "later", not a line of lamplighter

cases.name: a recipe unlock of both kinds
expect: recipes.json: meadow_tea: unlock needs "skill" and "level", or "collection" and "tier"

cases.name: a stat missing from stats.json

stats.json: missing stat "luck"
